state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 3 half written.** Every Core class and member page is generated, and nothing under `website/src/content/docs/reference/core/` is a file but the landing `index.mdx`.

`website/src/pages/reference/core/[...slug].astro` renders each class and member from `core.json`, the member's `about.md` and its examples. `website/src/lib/feature.ts` reads both in place, parses the `related:` line and fails the build on a name with no page. A section with nothing in it is left out, and "Not documented yet" is gone from the built site. Each member's `examples` field in `core.json` is its roster path, written by `tools/nv/renderers/website-core.ts` with `classTail`. `website/README.md` § *How the Core reference works* is the home of the page's shape.

The published set is still the spec's tables crossed with the registry: 26 classes and 299 members. The roster has many more Core members (`Http`, `Cli`, `BigInt` and others), which have no page yet. `--check reference` needs every one of them.

Nine members' `about.md` gained the facts their old page had and a `related:` line. No other `about.md` has one yet.

`site structure` and `site stale` pass. `snippets` and `prose` still fail on the pages stages 5 and 6 rewrite.

items.text: **One dynamic route renders every Core member from `core.json`, its `about.md` and all its examples, and the per-member `.mdx` stubs are deleted.** Anchor: `website/src/pages/reference/core/[...slug].astro:1`
**No empty heading, and `related:` lines in `about.md` render as links and fail the build on an unknown id.** Anchor: `website/src/lib/feature.ts:1`

**Every Core class the registry holds is published, not only those the spec's tables name.** `parseSpec` keeps a class only when `docs/spec/01-core-library.md` has its table, so a registry class without one gets no page. Build a member record from the registry's own signature for those. Goal § Stage 3 *`--check reference`* (every Core feature in the roster has a page). Anchors: `tools/nv/renderers/website-core.ts:607`, `tools/nv/renderers/website-core.ts:680`, `tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts:266`

**Configuration and CLI sub-areas, one page per `nvs.toml` block and per command.** Goal § Stage 3 *Three sub-areas*. Anchors: `website/astro.config.ts:116`, `website/src/pages/reference/core/[...slug].astro:1`
**`--check reference`, replacing its "not written yet" entry in `LATER`.** Goal § Stage 3 *`--check reference`*. Anchor: `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts:64`

backlog: A class page's summary is the spec chapter's prose, with rule ids and internal words in it. It needs a plain description, and no file owns one yet — `website/src/components/ClassOverview.astro`.
`related:` lines for the other members where a reader clearly wants the link — goal § Stage 3 *Related*.
Stage 5, Install, Guides and the Notes app — goal § Stage 5.
Stage 6, In-Depth, the home page and the plain-English read — goal § Stage 6.
The wrap gate infers a stale page's cause from the paths changed. ADR 0262 § Revisiting names when to hash the card at the session's base instead.
